column1: # One line per object that a human has adjudicated. An explicit line beats every
# pattern rule in classification-rules.tsv. This is the file that turns the
# census red into governed green, and every line in it is a decision somebody
#   compatibility_state : none | bounded:<retirement owner or task> | retired
# Purpose is prose and may contain spaces; it must not contain a tab.
# The generator prints an UNCLASSIFIED list after every run. That list is the
# work queue for this file. Do not classify from the object name alone - read the
# creator script the census names in the creator_authority column, because the
# script that made an object is the best available statement of why it exists.
# (empty on first install - the first census tells you exactly what belongs here)
